text:
nina_csm: Heads-up on AsterBank renewal. They want Dedicated mid-term, asking to waive setup fee and add quarterly true-up. Usage plateaued last qtr.
leo_sales: exec sponsor wants price protection for 6 months and no retroactive credits.
ravi_revops: waive setup fee requires a credit memo flow. need PO details and currency.
sara_legal: i'll draft an amendment: quarterly true-up, 30d notice for downgrades, and acceptance tests for migration.
indra_se: migration effort estimate: 8 engineer hours, one maintenance window ~45m. cross-region DB copy may add time.
nina_csm: customer proposes: setup waived if 20 seats active in 30 days else setup billed. Thoughts?
leo_sales: offer: 50% waived + 3 enablement sessions, or 100% waived if 20 seats in 30d. preserves upside.
ravi_revops: prefer staged credit: 50% upfront waiver, remaining 50% contingent on adoption measured by active seat tokens. need GL codes.
billing-bot: Reminder: generate invoice schedule after SOW upload. Net30 default unless PO requests Net45.
sara_legal: include measurement method: active seat = seat with >0 tokens in 7-day window at day30. will add to amendment.
nina_csm: i'll send SOW + amendment v0 to their procurement (Helena) today and loop you all in. risk: low adoption -> renewal at risk. logged.
